system:
You are assembling a clinical visit note. The sentences of one note are listed below in random order with their section headings removed. File every sentence under one of these four headings: SUBJECTIVE, OBJECTIVE EXAM, OBJECTIVE RESULTS, ASSESSMENT AND PLAN. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

<sentences>
S1: The patient did consume a 7 ounce bottle this morning, but mostly denied the next offered bottle and declined cereal.
S2: Symptoms began yesterday around dinnertime with clear nasal drainage, pulling on his ears bilaterally, and rubbing his nose frequently.
S3: When the patient aroused this morning, he was warm to the touch.
S4: I counseled the mother that she should be careful not to get the shampoo in the patient eyes and to not use the extra strength shampoos.
S5: Additionally, I suggested trying Zarbee’s for children under 1 years old.
S6: Cough, nasal congestion, and rhinorrhea.
S7: His rectal temperature was 100.3 degrees.
S8: The patient is experiencing worsening symptoms of dandruff.
S9: I also provided counseling to the mother to avoid giving honey to the patient for his first year of life due to botulism spores.
S10: He is accompanied by his mother.
S11: Treatment has included saline nasal spray, Tylenol, baby Vick's, and a humidifier.
S12: If a croup cough develops, the patient will receive a 0.5 teaspoon.
S13: Additionally, he may also use baby oil and a soft brush on the area.
S14: The patient presents with a viral infection and does not need antibiotics currently.
S15: He does not have a barky cough or a sore throat.
S16: I recommended Head and Shoulders shampoo, Selsun Blue, or Nizoral A-D 2 times per week, combined with his usual shampoo.
S17: Return in one week for a re-check.
S18: The patient has been exposed to an older sister who is sick and a cousin who has a sinus infection.
S19: When his sleeper was removed, he was quite sweaty despite the air conditioner being on.
S20: Randy Gutierrez is a 9-month-old male who is being evaluated today for a cough, nasal congestion, and rhinorrhea.
S21: Ears, Eyes, Nose, Throat
S22: The patient's dandruff is also worsening.
S23: I advised continuation of fluids, rest.
S24: Nasal congestion, clear mucus, rhinorrhea.
S25: The only tried treatment is Aveeno shampoo.
S26: Bilateral pulling of ears, no sore throat or hoarseness.
S27: Temperature 100.3 degrees.
S28: He is irritable and having trouble falling asleep, described “like he is fighting it”.
</sentences>

Return only the JSON object with the four keys.
